page.overview:
Who is Aegis of Gaia?

Aegis of Gaia, known as Divine Protection of the Goddess in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Aegis of Gaia".

Aegis of Gaia appears in the video game,Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. She appears as a Level One Theme Duelist and she challenges the player to restore 10000 or more Life Points during a duel. By beating her, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Two Theme Duelists and a new Booster Pack.
